Ecuador i 1809 a mihcaan waluay idaw ku cacay bataan patukuh a miliyas tu Spain a nikuwanan masacacay sakelec ku nida sa patideng tu kanatal. ya u telekelal patelek tu Ecuador a kanatalan, sisa u Spain uyni u telekelal (ecuador) palu kanatal nu ngangan, zayhan kina kanatal idaw ku kasingangan han tu, hakya mahini yadah ku pada' kyu pangangan hantu tu "pada' a kanatal". u tatangahan a tusu i Pi-cing-ca u silamalay a buyu' u kitidaan kya buyu', namakay bayu nu telek katalakaw 2,850 a depah, sisa kina tusu u sakatusa katalakaw i kitakiay a tusu (mikilul tu i Pu-li-wya-ya a tusu nu La-pa-si ). miduduc tu bayu' a kitidaan nu niyadu' idaw tu ku maliwasakay nu muenengay. i 1463 a mihcaan malu nu Inca a kanatal ku nikahida. i Spain makatepa tu baluhayay sa, u Ecuador i 1532 a mihcaan debungan nu Spain a tademaw, namahayda maselep tu ku Spain nu malimatay a tademaw i kitidaan pina tu hakya a lasubuan nu mihca. . 1809 a mihcaan walu a bataan idaw ku cacay a bataan misakamu a masacacay, nika kalankan maala aca nu Spain , misadakay tu pinaay tu nu mihcaan, 1822 a mihcaan kya u tatengaay tu miales tu Spain nipikuwan. 1825 a mihcaan milabu tu tabakiay a Columbia masakaputay mapulung a kanatal, nika kina kanatal i 1830 a mihcaan maliwasak. u Ecuador a masakaputay mapulung a kanatal kyu patideng. 1809年8月10 . ya kanatal nanipatideng caay kacakad ku cen-ce nu Ecuador , u micudaday atu hitayay a nika kutakutay nu sihu makatukuh cacay idaw ku siwa, naw 1979 a mihcaan u tatengaay tu u micudaday a sihu ku mikuwanay, patideng tu hulic, hida han miyun tu tusa a bataan nu mihcaan. . 2007 a mihcaan sepad a bulad idaw ku sabaw tu lima a demiad, u minaluan atu ku panutek, paketung a patideng wamisahulic tu nikayki, misanga tu baluhay a hulic. 2019 a mihcaan enen a bulad idaw ku sabaw nisulit u tatengaay tu kya nikalaacawa tu tatayna u tatayna atu tatama u tatama a malaacawaay tu pacudad. i 2019 a mihcaan cacay a bataan, Ecuador a sihu namilawpes tu sapadansu tu simal nu sapaaca Ecuador i satipan nu waliyu , idaw ku 2,237 km nu sadipasan, u ahebal nu lala' 283,561 km2. Ecuador nu saamisan atu Columbia laed malcapi (708 km) atu sawali nu timuan atu Peru malalidemuh tu (1,529 kun-li). Ecuador hamin u ahebal nu lala' 28 a mang 3,520 km2. pasu nu Ciya-la-pa-ke a subal. sikasan, u ahebal nu lala' 27 aman idaw ku 6,841 km2, u nanum nu ahebal 6,720 km2. i Nan-mei-cul , Ecuador u ahebal nu lala' kiahebalan ku Uruguay , Suriname , Guyana atu tungus nu France a Guyana . tusu Ecuador a tusu u sakatusa yadah ku tabakiay a tusu. u satabakiay a tusu i Kuwa-ya-ci-er . u dumaay sakahenulan nu tusu idaw ku Kun-ka , An-pa-tul , Pul-tu-wei-ye-hul , Ma-ca-la , Lul-ha . ,馬查拉,洛哈. manamec Ecuador u matanengay ku nikaudip maka malingatuay a kanatal, u manamecay u milihidaay a simalay ku sakaudip, u sakatahkal nu malukay a tuud u sasazayliawan. 2000 a mihcaan kina kanatal micuduh tu nu Amilikay a kalisiw ku nipikuwan, namahida satu sa sikacacekin tu ku tademaw makai' tu nu aydaay a nipikakuwan kyu mapaales, nika malaheci tu nu Amilika a kalisiw midayli tu sangalep ku mahiniay u tung-ho-pun-cang u kasenengan nikacaay kacakad ku malumanay a kalisiw nu Su-ke-lei . Ecuador u salengacay nu hana u siwni Lan han kya hana nu kanatal, u palang a kakawsan nu An-ti-si a kanatal. . tademaw Ecuador a kanatal u ahebal nu lala' tusa idaw ku walu a mang tulu malebud lima lasubu idaw ku enan a bataan nu pin-hawan-kun-li, u tademaw 1522 amang 3680 ku tademaw (2011 a mihcaan a nasulitan), naw u Spain nu malimatay a tademaw, i labu nu tademaw yadah ku caayay kalecad, masanad ku Yin-O malamelay nu tademaw (May-se-ti-sul a tademaw , Mestizos) u tademaw hamin idaw ku 41%, u Indian a tademaw 34%, u salengacay a tademaw 15%, namahini satu idaw hen ku makay Africa pataydaen i Nan-mei-cul palakalungen kya tademawan u lumeniay a tademaw atu lumeniay salengacay u makungkuay tu tademaw. mahida tu nu La-tin-mei-cul katuuday a kanatal, Ecuador a nieneng u nipisinciya sa nu malamelay tu Indian a laylayan ku pasayda i tinsukiw, u tatangahan a kamu nu Spain , nika u Indian a binacadan u nu Ke-ciw-ya ku kamu. . malalitin tu ihekalay atu zumaay a natinengan CIA 外交部
